The '''Hooded Occultists''' are four [[NPCs]] located in an underground cave in {{zone|Torrhus Canyon}}. This cave can be accessed from {{Coords|-676|90|257}}. There is no known implementation of the NPCs or any information about their structure.

== Purpose ==
The four '''Hooded Occultists''' walk around a fountain and randomly switch walking clockwise or counterclockwise.
